description.content:
Vault objects are used to configure different vault connectors for [managing secrets](https://developer.konghq.com/gateway/secrets-management/). Configuring a vault lets you reference secrets from other entities. This allows for a proper separation of secrets and configuration and prevents secret sprawl.

For example, you could store a certificate and a key in a vault, then reference them from a certificate entity. This way, the certificate and key are not stored in the entity directly and are more secure.

Secrets rotation can be managed using [TTLs](https://developer.konghq.com/gateway/entities/vault/).
